blockers.finding_verbatim: BLOCKER — no deployment occurred and the device is physically unreachable; no on-device sha256.
blockers.body_verbatim: Fresh probes this pass on DQ05: `curl -m8 http://192.168.1.1:2121/` -> `curl: (28) timeout`, http_code=000, rc=28; `curl -m8 http://192.168.8.1:2121/` -> `curl: (7) connection refused`, http_code=000, rc=7; `ping -c2 192.168.1.1` -> 100% packet loss; `ping -c2 192.168.8.1` -> 2/2 replies.
